{{Quote|Echo Base, this is Rogue Two. I've found them. Repeat, I've found them.|Zev Senesca, after locating [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Zev Senesca''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he flew as [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. However, he was killed when his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] was shot down by an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Zev Senesca was born and raised on [[Kestic Station/Legends|Kestic Station]], a trading outpost on the fringes of the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]]. A stopover point for free-traders with no affiliations, especially ties to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Senesca became familiar and skilled in the life of a trader and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. His [[Zev Senesca's parents|parents]] were persons of high ideals. They were known for trading in virtually any kind of good and, in their later years, began running arms for the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Although supplying the Rebellion was illegal and punishable by death, they felt they were doing the right thing and sought to instill this same kind of morality in their son. Growing up in such a free environment and surrounded by people with such strong ethical values, Senesca was a perfect candidate for recruitment by the Rebellion. His parents encouraged him to leave Kestic and take up arms with the Rebellion, which he soon did.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

Under his parents, Kestic soon became a vital link in the Alliance's supply chain. However, Rebel supply lines were traced back to the [[Space station/Legends|station]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Merciless (Star Destroyer)|''Merciless'']], on a tip from an informant, arrived and, without stopping to take prisoners or ask questions, destroyed the station. All aboard were killed, including Senesca's parents. His response to this tragedy was not grief, but anger. He blamed the Alliance for the destruction of Kestic Station, and for the death of his parents. And so, after no more than a year of fighting for the Rebellion, he left the Alliance and headed for deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and a life as a free-trader.<ref name="GG3" />

It was not long until Senesca learned the shocking truth about what happened. A "friend" he had confided in concerning Kestic's Rebel involvement was the informant who revealed the station's ties to the Empire. He had trusted this "friend," and the leak in security of the supply line was Senesca's fault. This realization gave him a newfound attitude toward the Rebellion, and he came to accept his own responsibility. It was not long after this that Zev rejoined the Alliance to fight the true enemy—the Empire.<ref name="GG3" /><ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

===Returning to the Rebellion===
{{Quote|Commander Skywalker, do you copy? This is Rogue Two. This is Rogue Two. Captain Solo, do you copy? Commander Skywalker, do you copy? This is Rogue Two.|Zev Senesca searching for Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Zev-hd.png|thumb|left|250px|Zev smiles after making contact with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].]]
Senesca's second stint with the Rebellion saw him become known as a worthy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. During the evacuation of the Rebel base at [[Alis Point]], Senesca single-handedly held off three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], while an unarmed [[Transport/Legends|transport]] fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the action that the pilot was most proud of in his work with the Alliance.<ref name="GG3" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Senesca served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arhul Narra/Legends|Arhul Narra]] in the newly rebuilt [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. He accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and temporary [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on a [[reconnaissance mission to Kamino]], returning to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with news of the mission's failure after Skywalker, Solo, and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] crashed to the [[Kamino/Legends|planet's]] surface.<ref name="RFF">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

Six months after Yavin, Senesca flew with Skywalker's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]].<ref name="RS/RF" /> He was the oldest member of the [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] throughout his service with them, and kept to himself. Senesca flew with the Rogues for early missions such as an [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|escort run]] on [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]] and the [[Search for the Nonnah|search]] for the ''[[Nonnah]]''. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he assisted in the [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|defection]] of [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], and that of [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]] following the [[liberation of Gerrard V]]. Using Moor's knowledge, Senesca and the Rogues struck at Imperial targets in a [[Battle of the Jade Moon|battle]] over the [[Jade Moon supply base]], a [[Raid on Balmorra|raid]] on the weapons facilities of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and an [[Assault on Kile II|assault]] on [[Kile II]]'s [[Imperial Enclave]].<ref name="RS" />

After [[Rescue on Kessel|rescuing]] Wedge Antilles from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], Senesca fought with the Rogues in the campaign against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kohl Seerdon]], including a [[Battle above Taloraan|raid]] on Imperial [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas facilities above [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]; the [[Escape from Fest|destruction]] of the [[Weapons Research Facility]] on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]; the [[Blockade on Chandrila|Battle of Chandrila]]; the Rogues' [[Raid on Sullust|raid]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]; and in [[Battle of Thyferra (5 ABY)|defense]] of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] facilities on the planet [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], in which Seerdon was finally killed.<ref name="RS" />

Seven months after Yavin, on a [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to establish a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], Senesca and Antilles helped defend grounded members of Red Squadron from TIE fighters on an [[Lubang Minor|uncharted world]]. Due in part to Senesca's actions, Skywalker and Narra escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with their lives, and in the company of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Able]].<ref name="SWE" />

Along with the rest of the Rogues, Senesca was assigned to the newly formed [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] to protect the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. When Skywalker failed to return from a routine scouting mission in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Han Solo went out to locate his missing friend. Neither returned before nightfall, when the base's shield doors had to be closed to protect the base from the planet's brutal icy winds. At daybreak, Senesca, under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]], led the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] patrol sent out to locate them. He successfully found Skywalker and Solo stranded amid the snow, having survived an overnight blizzard.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:Rogue_Two_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Zev Senesca flying as Rogue Two during the Battle of Hoth.]]
When the Empire discovered the Rebel base and launched a massive ground [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|assault]] soon thereafter, Senesca once again manned his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and flew with the ad hoc Rogue Group to hold off the invasion to buy time for the base's [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transports]] to evacuate. He managed to maintain control of his craft through most of the battle despite being hit by several laser barrages by the horde of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Late in the battle, he formed up with Skywalker on an approach of the Imperial line, ordered to try and bring down one of the walkers with the speeder's [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]], a trick that Antilles had successfully employed to bring down one of the walkers earlier. As his gunner, [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]], prepared his tow cable, Senesca, Skywalker, and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] approached, his speeder suffered several direct hits from multiple walkers and he was killed along with his gunner.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back novel'']]</ref>

During his time with the Rebellion, Senesca was distinguished for his actions in combat. In his career, he had 48 confirmed kills and received several commendations for his actions.<ref name="GG3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zev Senesca was portrayed by the late [[Christopher Malcolm]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. For [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]], he was voiced by [[Jerry Zaks]].<ref name="Encyclopedia of Radio">{{BookCite|author=Christopher H. Sterling |title=Encyclopedia of Radio |number=vol. 3 |publisher=Routledge |date=2004 |isbn=9781135456498 |link=https://books.google.com/books?id=-UeveLMilioC&dq=Frank%20Mankiewicz%20star%20wars&pg=PA2206 }}</ref>

A helmet styled after Zev's film helmet was used by [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] and another, unidentified pilot in the [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] briefing room scene in the film.<ref name="SW Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>

The character should not be confused with [[Zevulon Veers|Zev Veers]], the son of [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] who appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'', set after Senesca's death.

Within the Star Wars 3 and 3/4 inch figure line, there have been two releases of Zev Senesca. The first figure came in the Saga Collection's "Rogue Two Snowspeeder" vehicle, an exclusive toy sold at Target toy stores in 2006. Zev proved so popular with collectors that the figure was released again in 2008 in the [[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]. Zev was chosen by fans in late 2007 as the winner of the Saga Legends Showdown, he was also the last figure to be released in the Saga Legends collection. Both figures of Zev were identical, the only differences being in the decoration of the removable helmet and the addition of a blaster pistol supplied with the 30th Anniversary Collection figure.
